text: DSH Edit Message 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的消息编辑插件。它在对话输入框工具栏注册“编辑上一条消息”按钮，并从聊天记录中定位最近一条用户或 steering 消息。会话空闲且消息只含文本时，点击按钮会将原文恢复到输入框并聚焦，方便修改后重新发送；会话运行中、没有用户消息或消息含图片等非文本内容时按钮不显示。它适合希望快速调整刚发送内容的 DSH Web 用户。使用前需在 Web profile 安装插件，不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。
想把刚才发出的消息改几个字再重新发送。
DSH 有没有办法把上一条提问找回输入框？
停止回复后，我想修改原问题并重问。
让聊天输入框恢复最近一条纯文本用户消息。
How can I revise my last prompt and send it again?
Restore my previous text message to the chat composer.
DSH Edit Message 的功能「恢复最近一条纯文本消息」：在会话空闲时，按钮查找聊天记录中最近的 user 或 steering 消息；点击后将文本放回输入框，供修改和重发。
DSH Edit Message 的功能「仅在可编辑状态显示」：会话正在运行、没有聊天快照或找不到用户消息时，不显示编辑按钮。
DSH Edit Message 的功能「恢复后聚焦输入框」：恢复文本后优先调用输入动作提供的 focus；否则聚焦标记的编辑区域，并兼容旧版 textarea。
上一条消息里有图片时，有没有办法只恢复文字？
我想在聊天框里继续编辑刚才发送的文本。

DSH Edit Message adds an “Edit last message” button to the Web composer. When idle, it restores the latest plain-text user or steering message and focuses the input. The button is hidden while a turn runs or the message contains non-text content. No API key or external service is needed.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · dsh-plugin-edit-message：**English** · [中文](README.zh.md)

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin: **edit the last user message back into
the composer after stopping a turn** — no more retyping from scratch.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Why：Sending a message, stopping the reply, and wanting to re-ask with a small
change currently means typing the whole prompt again. This plugin adds an
"Edit last message" button to the composer tool row: it restores the tail user
message text and focuses the input, ready to edit and send.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Why：It is a **client-side plugin** — the conversation log stays append-only. Sending
the edited text appends a new turn (the original message and the interrupted
reply remain in the transcript). It never touches the host, the session log,
or the agent loop.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Install：The plugin bundles as a `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client` package. It works on any
DSH setup that loads third-party bundles (source `dsh web`, DSH Desktop,
custom profiles).

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · From npm (published — recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-edit-message
```

Restart the GUI (fully quit and reopen) after installing — client plugin
bundles register at startup.

**DSH Desktop users:** Desktop's `DSH_HOME` lives under
`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness`, so target that explicitly:

```bash
DSH_HOME="${APPDATA}/dsh-desktop/harness" \
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-edit-message
```

Then quit and reopen DSH Desktop.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · From this source checkout：The repository is self-contained: devDependencies resolve the official
harness client packages from the npm registry, so no `deepseek-harness`
checkout is needed.

```sh
pnpm install     # pulls the official client packages from npm
pnpm run build   # emits lib/index.js + lib/client.js + lib/types
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-plugin-edit-message
dsh --profile <name>

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · From this source checkout：Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-plugin-edit-message`.
See `docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md` in the harness checkout for the
`dsh plugin` workflow.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · How it works：- Registers one client plugin (`dsh.client` manifest, `platform: web`) that
  contributes an entry to the official `conversation.input.left` composer
  tool-row slot (a documented multi-plugin list slot — zero official changes).
- The button renders only while the session is idle, a tail user/steering
  message exists, and that message is plain text (draft images are browser
  File-backed and cannot be resurrected from the durable log).
- On click: `inputActions.setDraft(text)` restores the text and the composer
  is focused. The plugin prefers `inputActions.focus` when the deployed
  runtime exposes it, otherwise it focuses the editable surface —
  `[data-composer-input]` on harness 0.1.2+ (a Lexical-driven
  `contenteditable`), with the legacy composer `<textarea>` as the last
  fallback.
- If you remove the plugin (`dsh plugin remove dsh-plugin-edit-message`), the
  surface disappears entirely — the tool row reverts to official chrome.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Compatibility：The plugin tracks the harness client contract, which was reshaped twice inside
the **0.1.2** line:

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Compatibility：1. `0.1.2-alpha` split the monolithic `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` into
   `dsh-client-store` + the `dsh-client-ui-*` family, and moved the transcript
   off `SessionSnapshot` (whose `chat` field no longer exists) onto the Chat
   target published per Conversation binding, reached through the `useChat`
   standard hook.
2. `0.1.2-rc.1` stopped handing the composer tool row its `InputZone` owner
   props: the responder now calls
   `renderSlot("conversation.input.left", {})`. Session lifecycle therefore
   comes from the `useSession` standard hook, which ui-session contributes for
   every session-scoped slot on every 0.1.2 build.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Compatibility：| Plugin | Harness / DSH Desktop | Reads |
|---|---|---|
| 0.1.5+ | 0.1.2-alpha.1 … 0.1.2-rc.1 (Desktop 0.7.x / 0.8.x) | `useChat` + `useSession`; **no owner props** |
| 0.1.4 | 0.1.2-alpha.1 … 0.1.2-alpha.5 (Desktop 0.7.x) | `useChat` + the `InputZone` owner prop |
| ≤ 0.1.3 | 0.1.0-rc.x (Desktop ≤ 0.5.0) | `session.chat` |

Both 0.1.2 breaking changes fail the slot silently for older builds — the button
simply never appears, with the crash below in the console:

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Compatibility：```
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.input.left':
  TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'order')   // <= 0.1.3 on 0.1.2-alpha
  TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'running') // 0.1.4 on 0.1.2-rc.1
```

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Differences from in-transcript editing (Codex style)：In-place replacement with a rewind of the log tail is a larger design
(log-truncation semantics, compaction checkpoints, session log format, dual
SDK projections) and is intentionally out of scope. This plugin provides the
interaction value — edit the text, resend — with zero blast radius.

dsh-plugin-edit-message README · Develop：```sh
pnpm run typecheck   # tsc --noEmit (strict)
pnpm run test        # vitest (logic matrix + component behavior)
pnpm run build       # tsdown → lib/client.js + types
```

`pnpm publish` runs `prepublishOnly` (typecheck + test + build) first.
